about: r12-8 — ONE title rule for a member change, used by Activity rows and sheets alike: the link door's `names.change {action, labels}` → `{key, params, count?}` or null. `action` is the core's Action JSON (`addOwner`, `removeOwner`, `swapOwner`, `changeThreshold`; anything else is null). Each member is named by `names.who` with `labels[lowercase address]` — the accounts machine's `member_labels` (on a sheet, the name typed for the member there, else that). The shell fills the key in the page's language when it DRAWS the row — never a title frozen when it was written ("Add 0xD40086…de130b" on a zh Activity beside "Add Dana Local (…)" on the sheet). `count`: say the key's plural form for it (`_one` / `_other`). Replay each case through the door and compare the whole answer.

cases.name: r12-8: an added member with a kept name — the sheet's words, on Activity too
a label keyed in any case is the member's
no name known: the short form alone
a label that is the short form itself is no name
a threshold: its plural family and the count
not a member change: no title from this rule
